thread:
lucy-marketing: Quick ask for tomorrow's launch runbook: can runtime run a tiny 'emerald' fidelity probe to validate coldstart + cached behavior across payloads? Need deliverables by 08:30 PT.

Specs: 32 requests (11 short, 11 medium, 10 long), models: redwood-base-7b fp16 and llm-lite-6b-q4 fallback. Baseline without KV cache, plus one cached comparison. Include: per-request CSV (with seq_len and batch_size), percentile summary (p50/p90/p99), coldstart heatmap PNG, sampled traces (p95+), and a single logits snapshot for the longest outlier. Keep total wall time <25m.

omar-runtime: We can run that. Two quick clarifications: 1) do you want node-level annotation in the CSV? 2) sampling policy: sample all p95+ traces and also the first cold request on each node?

lucy-marketing: Yes to node-level annotation. And yes to sampling policy you described.

kai-platform: Note: gpu-dedicated-9 has a scheduled kernel patch at 03:00-04:30 PT, recommend slot after 05:30 PT to avoid noise.

omar-runtime: Scheduling baseline at 05:45 PT (run_id=em-1890012401), cached comparison at 06:20 PT. Concurrency capped at 4 to mimic demo environment. Output: latencies.csv, percentiles.png, heatmap.png, traces.tgz, logits_snapshot.npy.gz. Will include node tags in CSV.

bench-bot: Job queued: em-1890012401 (est 16m).

omar-runtime: Started em-1890012401. Running payload sweep.

bench-bot: em-1890012401 completed. Artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/runs/em-1890012401/emerald_probe_v1.tar.gz

lucy-marketing: Downloaded. Seeing a p99 spike for long payload req-028. Can you attach trace and logits and a short note on root cause?

omar-runtime: Included traces/req-028.json and snapshots/logits-req-028.npy.gz in the tarball. Short note: the spike aligns with a transient host interrupt during first-token decode on gpu-dedicated-9; appears infra-related not model/runtime-level. Re-ran the single long case on gpu-dedicated-10 and spike did not reproduce.

kai-platform: We'll flag gpu-dedicated-9 for follow-up and prefer gpu-dedicated-10 for the rehearsal slot.

lucy-marketing: Great. Can you add a short 3-bullet summary marketing can paste into the rehearsal doc?

omar-runtime: Summary posted: "Emerald fidelity probe (n=32; short/medium/long) on redwood-base-7b (fp16) with llm-lite-6b-q4 fallback. Artifacts: per-request CSV (seq_len, batch_size, node), percentile plots, coldstart heatmap, sampled traces (p95+), and a logits snapshot for the long outlier. Observed isolated p99 tied to host interrupt on gpu-dedicated-9; not reproduced on gpu-dedicated-10. Recommendation: schedule rehearsal on gpu-dedicated-10 and monitor overnight."

lucy-marketing: Perfect 680 Thanks all 389 Closing thread; will ping if we need a rerun.
